SELECT 
    SUM(t.Amount) AS total_spent,
    SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date = '201201' THEN t.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS january_2012_spent
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    yearmonth y ON t.CustomerID = y.CustomerID AND STRFTIME('%Y%m', t.Date) = y.Date
WHERE 
    t.CustomerID = 38508
